items.title: Black Friday 2026 Fast-Food Deals Worth Leaving the Couch For

items.summary: Holiday season has officially taken over fast-food menus and grocery aisles. Here are the biggest Christmas 2026 limited-time drops worth putting on your radar across Krispy Kreme, McDonald's, Burger King, Chick-fil-A, Wendy's, Trader Joe's, and Hershey's.

items.title: IHOP: IHOP Just Announced Its First Ever Collectible Mug
items.summary: It’s not just you. Holiday collectibles are having a moment. Between blind boxes and collectible cups, they’ve even started to take over the food industry. They’re so prominent that one restaurant is joining in on the fun for the first time ever. Who’s the restaurant in question? None other than IHOP! IHOCHM The International House of Pancakes?

items.title: Fast-Food & Snack Desk: We Found a Way to Get 12 Bottles of Wine for $5 Each, and It’s Perfect for the Holidays
items.summary: If there’s one thing the holiday season has a way of teaching us it’s that you can never have too much wine on hand. Between holiday parties, family gatherings, and winding down with a few minutes to yourself, having good wine in the pantry is a necessity this time of year.

items.title: Fast-Food & Snack Desk: How To Grab Jamba’s Focker-In-Law Smoothie Deal
items.summary: Thanksgiving week is bringing plenty of family gatherings, awkward conversations, and, apparently, a very funny smoothie deal. Jamba is joining the fun ahead of the release of Focker-in-Law, the latest movie in the Meet the Parents franchise.

Suddenly, lunch and dinner are already sorted!

items.title: Fast-Food & Snack Desk: The Best Ways To Use Thanksgiving Leftovers (That Aren’t Turkey Sandwiches)

There are plenty of ways to put those Thanksgiving leftovers to good use without making another turkey sandwich. Some of these ideas are so good, you’d wish you had more leftovers to play around with.

items.summary: 2026 was a pretty good year for Oreo! Not only did they come out with some wow-worthy classic flavors but their Thins got some time in the spotlight and even the Oreo Cakesters were able to join in the fun as well. The whole family got involved. Now all that’s left is to see which are the best of the best. The most impressive.

items.title: Fast-Food & Snack Desk: REVIEW: Eggo Zero Buttermilk Waffles
